title: Assistant Professor of Business Administration
bio: Overview My research examines how firms and households make financial decisions, with a focus on the role of the family. My work evaluates how financial regulations shape credit and consumption disparities within the household and the extent to which business owners' family life events drive firm growth and investment. I also study topics in financial intermediation and federal programs targeting small business growth. Keywords: Household Finance ; Entrepreneurship ; Corporate Finance ; Financial Intermediation
